blockers.title: Unhealthy owned API target prevents exact rollback before CAS, while coordination is released
blockers.cause: restore_backends calls normal compatible before restoring owned candidate bytes; normal compatible and rollback Node reloader require target online and positive pid. A failed owned candidate reload can leave errored/stopped/launching status with unchanged identity/path/CWD/env. Recovery then aborts before CAS, but failure handler sets shared_release_active=false and releases locks.
blockers.minimalFix: Separate owned-recovery identity/configuration invariants from normal health invariants in Python and Node; retain exact id/path/CWD/env/worker/CAS protection, permit causally owned target liveness failure in rollback, restore original bytes and recover only original target instances. Keep failed/incomplete-recovery coordination occupied until exact recovery is confirmed. Add focused offline unhealthy-target rollback and incomplete-recovery-window fixtures.
